data.one_liner: Mixin that lets widgets watch GetIt‑registered objects and rebuild on changes.
data.what_it_does: Provides GetItMixin and related mixins to read and watch ChangeNotifier, ValueNotifier, Stream or Future instances stored in GetIt. It automatically manages subscriptions and rebuilds the widget when the data changes.
use_when: You already use GetIt for dependency injection and want UI to react to changes without manual StreamBuilder or ValueListenableBuilder
You need a lightweight way to bind widget rebuilds to simple listenable objects
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured state‑management solution like Bloc or Riverpod
You require code‑generation or advanced features not offered by this mixin
strengths: Very little boilerplate compared to manual builders
Works directly with existing GetIt registrations
weaknesses: Strict ordering rules for watch calls can be error‑prone
